source.mapping_method: Read-only immutable Git trees; current commit identity verified remotely by parent, exact local tree verified independently. No live post-freeze TUI content used.

excluded: Later26-path TUI picker adoption and failed TUI gate

intentional_changes: Replace direct native run/session construction at App Server with one selected provider and connection scopes. Preserve original lexical roots and real native matching options. Explicit selected errors do not activate fallback.
App Server transport, request dispatch, admission and presentation remain compiled host consumer adapters; they are not independently installed App Server replacements.
boundaries.ownership: SearchShutdownGuard owns the shared selected provider outside abortable processors; factories are weak and every connection/session has retained startup/update/close ownership.
limits: No observed per-request pending-start cancellation gate in the installed stdio acceptance.
Private rollout lookup remains coupled; this is not all search consumers.

intentional_changes: Retain query identity and snapshot-before-completion; distinguish deliberate stop from terminal failure.
Add bounded typed fuzzyFileSearch/sessionFailed notification with regenerated JSON/TypeScript/Python contracts. Failure notification is not a cleanup receipt.
boundaries.ownership: SearchObserver retains authoritative state; SearchPublisher owns the bounded presentation pump and cancellation fencing.
limits: First stable generator omitted SDK before/after capture; later SDK hashes and tests bind post-generation bytes only.
Exhaustive matches in four TUI files are compatibility plumbing, not selected TUI picker acceptance.

intentional_changes: Expose the selected search factory to local in-process consumers without another provider owner.
Coordinate deliberate shutdown before dropping observation and await normal search/storage cleanup; preserve operation error separately from unconfirmed cleanup.
boundaries.ownership: Client shutdown coordinator owns workers and guards even if its waiter disappears; provider close intent is explicit. Forced fallback boundaries remain a later P03 concern.
limits: Installed runtime gate is stdio EOF, not manager Launch Ctrl+C.
No newer GUI/storage regression on this frozen App Server.

intentional_changes: Choose explicit shared-provider resource ceilings and per-lease budgets rather than silent thread/matching substitutions.
Use real IndexedEntry/IndexAllocationPlan diagnostics for 2/12-thread,100k/250k,highlights-on/off cases.
boundaries.ownership: Shared composition enforces aggregate admission; native backend reserves actual charged storage. Accounting is not an OS/RSS quota.
limits: Measured fixed allocation floors and small traversal do not prove maximum production scale or RSS.
Encoded wire-frame accounting differs from native retained payload.
